Reads playback time in selected YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels, then advances after the configured play count. Long-video skipping uses a known total duration and safety checks. The optional timer advances only Instagram videos without progress information after the selected wait. Long-video, ad and YouTube live-preview options work independently of play count. Main execution off stops everything. A live-preview delay of 0 seconds means skip immediately. Optional visual analysis and capture require Android 14 or later and compare images only in device memory. Videos, accounts and viewing history are not stored or transmitted. This service reads screens and performs swipes. Optional photo-Reel automation reads slide indices and advances individual photos or the whole Reel.

Reads playback time in selected YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels, then swipes after the chosen play count.

Long-video skipping advances after safety checks when a known total duration meets the threshold, without waiting for a new start or completion. Range: 1–3600 seconds; default: 60. Unknown lengths are not guessed.

The optional timer advances only Instagram videos without progress information after the selected wait. Long-video, ad and YouTube live-preview options are independent of play count and also work at 0 plays. Main execution off stops all automation. Live delay is 0–60 seconds; 0 means skip immediately.

On Android 14 or later, separately enabled visual assistance compares Instagram video screens on this device when playback information is unavailable. Initial learning may add extra plays; this experimental feature does not guarantee an exact count. Older Android versions use basic features without screen capture.

Accessibility is a powerful permission that can read and interact with screens and, on Android 14 or later, capture them. Internet access is used only to check for and download GitHub updates. Videos, accounts, viewing history and screens are not stored or transmitted.

On the next screen, open Installed apps and enable this app’s service yourself. Its system label may follow another language in your system list. Do not change other accessibility services. Optional photo-Reel automation reads slide indices and advances individual photos or the whole Reel.

0 plays stops ordinary repeat and timer advancing. Long videos, ads, live previews and photo Reels are separate. Main execution off stops everything and closes the floating control.

Long-video skipping applies to ordinary videos in selected YouTube and Instagram apps when known total duration meets the threshold. It advances after safety checks without waiting for a playback start or completion. Off by default; threshold 60 seconds, adjustable from 1 to 3600. This is total length, not wait time. Unknown lengths are not guessed; Instagram without progress information follows the timer setting. With the option and main execution on, long videos can be skipped at 0 plays, but the timer stops at 0.

Immediate ad skipping works only for recognized ads in selected Instagram. With the ad option and main execution on, ads can be skipped at 0 plays.

Live-preview skipping works only for recognized live previews inside selected YouTube Shorts. Off by default. Delay 0 means skip immediately; 1–60 seconds is also available. With this option and main execution on, it also works at 0 ordinary plays. It does not change the ordinary play count or Instagram timer.

The timer applies only to Instagram videos without readable progress information. Off by default; initial wait 10 seconds, adjustable from 5 to 60. It is a wait time, not an exact completed-play count. It restarts after a detected pause, comments or another screen. Videos with normal progress information follow the play count unless they meet the long-video threshold.

Automation waits during comments, menus and app changes. Basic mode does not advance ordinary videos with unreadable progress or ordinary videos shorter than 3 seconds. Visual assistance is an experimental alternative for Instagram without playback information and does not guarantee an exact count. When both are on, the timer takes priority and the visual-assistance choice is kept. Small manual seeks may not be fully distinguished. App updates may affect detection.

Internet access is used only to check for and download updates. Videos, accounts and viewing history are not stored or transmitted. After the service reconnects, execution starts off for safety.

Photo Reels have an independent option that also works at 0 plays. Choose whole-Reel skipping or each-photo viewing and save separate 0–10-second delays. 0 means immediate after safety checks. Each-photo mode waits equally on the last photo. The optional unreadable-index fallback uses the whole-Reel delay; otherwise it waits.
